newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's April retail sales grew 2.4 pct vs yr ago.
newsitem.headline: Italy's April retail sales grew 2.4 pct vs yr ago.

text.p: Medium and large firms' April retail sales in Italy rose 2.4 percent from a year ago, national statistics institute Istat said.
Istat said April's retail sales index (1995=100) stood at 106.3 against 103.8 a year ago.
In the first four months of the year, retail sales grew 1.8 percent, Istat said.
The April increase included a 3.6-percent jump in sales at major distribution centres.
Smaller outlets registered a 2.2-percent sales increase. The value of food sales rose 3.2 percent while non-food sales gained 2.0 percent.
